title: Carb time alarm in BW not working
body: This feature does not appear to be working for several users according to Facebook comments. Does not appear to be a permissions issue. I've tried it on both a Jelly 2 (Android 10) and Pixel 3a (Android 11)

comments.body: Works in Samsung Galaxy S9 / Android 10.
Does not work for Pixel 4a 5g Android 11
It does not work in Mi A3, Android 11
This PR adds a second way to get the alarm - via the system alarm app (countdown/kitchen timer): https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/333
